articles.title: GPT‑6 Models Show Protein‑Design Skills
articles.titleZh: GPT‑6 模型展示蛋白质设计能力
articles.summaryZh: GPT‑6 能够设计蛋白质结构和序列，实验发现它能与五种靶标结合。

sentences.en: Scientists at OpenAI announced that GPT‑6 can design new protein structures and sequences.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 的科学家宣布 GPT‑6 能够设计新的蛋白质结构和序列。
sentences.tip: 主干：Scientists at OpenAI announced…；听：注意“design new protein structures and sequences”中的弱化。

sentences.en: The model uses advanced reasoning and code to predict how proteins fold.
sentences.zh: 该模型使用高级推理和代码来预测蛋白质如何折叠。
sentences.tip: 主干：The model uses…；听：关注“advanced reasoning and code”中的连读。

sentences.en: Lab tests showed the designed proteins could bind to five different biological targets.
sentences.zh: 实验室测试表明，设计的蛋白质能够与五种不同的生物靶标结合。
sentences.tip: 主干：Lab tests showed…；听：注意“bind to five different biological targets”中的弱化。

focus.text: bind to five different biological targets
focus.meaning: 与五种不同的生物靶标结合

sentences.en: This is the first time a language model has demonstrated real protein‑design capability.
sentences.zh: 这是语言模型首次展示真正的蛋白质设计能力。
sentences.tip: 主干：This is the first time…；听：注意“real protein‑design capability”中的弱化。

focus.meaning: 真正的蛋白质设计能力

sentences.en: The breakthrough could accelerate drug discovery by generating novel therapeutic proteins.
sentences.zh: 这一突破可能通过生成新型治疗蛋白加速药物发现。
sentences.tip: 主干：The breakthrough could accelerate…；听：关注“novel therapeutic proteins”中的连读。

sentences.en: Researchers plan to test the model on more complex proteins and larger datasets.
sentences.zh: 研究人员计划在更复杂的蛋白质和更大的数据集上测试该模型。
sentences.tip: 主干：Researchers plan to test…；听：注意“more complex proteins and larger datasets”中的弱化。

sentences.en: OpenAI will release a public API allowing scientists to experiment with GPT‑6 protein designs.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 将发布公共 API，让科学家尝试 GPT‑6 蛋白质设计。
sentences.tip: 主干：OpenAI will release…；听：关注“public API”中的弱化。

sentences.en: The next step is to validate the proteins in living cells and animal models.
sentences.zh: 下一步是验证蛋白质在活细胞和动物模型中的效果。
sentences.tip: 主干：The next step is to validate…；听：注意“living cells and animal models”中的连读。

quiz.q: What capability did GPT‑6 demonstrate in the lab tests?
quiz.explainZh: 实验室测试显示 GPT‑6 能够设计蛋白质结构和序列。

quiz.q: Which of the following is a potential benefit of this breakthrough?
quiz.explainZh: 突破可能加速药物发现，生成新型治疗蛋白。

articles.title: Claude AI Now Handles Pull Requests and Ship Fixes
articles.titleZh: Claude AI 现在能处理拉取请求并发布修复
articles.summaryZh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Ship，AI 可自动审查、修复并批准代码拉取请求，帮助工程师更快发布代码。

sentences.en: Anthropic has announced a new product called Claude Ship that can automatically review pull requests.
sentences.zh: Anthropic 宣布了一款名为 Claude Ship 的新产品，能够自动审查拉取请求。
sentences.tip: 主干：Anthropic has announced a new product；听：注意“has announced”的弱化和“product”重音。

sentences.en: The AI can also fix bugs in the code and approve the changes for deployment.
sentences.zh: AI 还可以修复代码中的错误并批准更改以进行部署。
sentences.tip: 主干：The AI can also fix bugs；听：连词“also”轻读，强调“fix”。

sentences.en: Engineers have already been using Claude’s Code Review feature to spot errors before merging code.
sentences.zh: 工程师已经在使用 Claude 的 Code Review 功能，在合并代码前发现错误。
sentences.tip: 主干：Engineers have already been using；听：过去完成时的弱化，注意“Code Review”。

focus.meaning: 在合并代码前发现错误

sentences.en: Claude Ship works by analyzing the pull request, suggesting changes, and then automatically applying them if approved.
sentences.zh: Claude Ship 通过分析拉取请求，建议更改，然后在批准后自动应用。
sentences.tip: 主干：Claude Ship works by analyzing；听：强调“analyzing”，注意“suggesting changes”。

sentences.en: The new feature is built on Anthropic’s existing Claude model, which already understands code syntax and logic.
sentences.zh: 该新功能基于 Anthropic 已有的 Claude 模型，该模型已能理解代码语法和逻辑。
sentences.tip: 主干：The new feature is built on；听：注意“built on”的弱化，重音在“Claude model”。

sentences.en: This means developers can save time by letting the AI handle routine review tasks.
sentences.zh: 这意味着开发者可以通过让 AI 处理日常审查任务来节省时间。
sentences.tip: 主干：This means developers can save time；听：注意“means”弱化，强调“save time”。

sentences.en: Companies using the platform report fewer bugs in production and faster release cycles.
sentences.zh: 使用该平台的公司报告生产环境中的错误更少，发布周期更快。
sentences.tip: 主干：Companies using the platform report；听：注意“report”的弱化，重音在“fewer bugs”。

sentences.en: Future updates may add support for other version control systems beyond GitHub.
sentences.zh: 未来更新可能会增加对 GitHub 之外其他版本控制系统的支持。
sentences.tip: 主干：Future updates may add；听：注意“may add”的弱化，强调“support”。

focus.text: support for other version control systems
focus.meaning: 支持其他版本控制系统

sentences.en: If you’re a software engineer, consider testing Claude Ship to see how it streamlines your workflow.
sentences.zh: 如果你是软件工程师，考虑测试 Claude Ship，看看它如何简化你的工作流程。
sentences.tip: 主干：If you’re a software engineer, consider testing；听：注意“consider”的弱化，重音在“streamlines”。

quiz.q: What is the main function of Claude Ship?
options: It creates new code from scratch
It automatically reviews and fixes pull requests
quiz.explainZh: Claude Ship 的主要功能是自动审查、修复并批准拉取请求。

quiz.q: Which platform might Claude Ship support in future updates?
quiz.explainZh: 未来更新可能会增加对 GitHub 之外其他版本控制系统的支持。

articles.title: UK Warns AI-Driven Cyberattacks Reveal Years of Weak Security
articles.titleZh: 英国警告 AI 驱动的网络攻击暴露多年安全薄弱点
articles.summaryZh: 英国网络机构警告，AI 黑客工具利用简单安全漏洞，强调基础建设的重要性。

sentences.en: The UK government has warned that AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing long‑standing security weaknesses.
sentences.zh: 英国政府警告，AI驱动的网络攻击正在暴露长期存在的安全弱点。
sentences.tip: 主干：UK government warned; 听：注意弱化的过去时态，连读。

focus.meaning: 由 AI 驱动的网络攻击
暴露长期存在的安全弱点

sentences.en: Cybersecurity experts say that the tools used by hackers rely on simple, often overlooked, flaws in software.
sentences.zh: 网络安全专家表示，黑客使用的工具依赖于软件中简单且常被忽视的缺陷。
sentences.tip: 主干：experts say; 听：注意连读的 'often overlooked'。

sentences.en: The British cyber agency, GCHQ, highlighted that building strong foundations has never mattered more.
sentences.zh: 英国网络机构 GCHQ 强调，建立坚固基础从未比现在更重要。
sentences.tip: 主干：GCHQ highlighted; 听：注意 'has never mattered more' 的强调。

sentences.en: GCHQ has been monitoring AI hacking tools for months, noting that many are designed to automate vulnerability discovery.
sentences.zh: GCHQ 已监控 AI 黑客工具数月，指出许多工具旨在自动化发现漏洞。
sentences.tip: 主干：GCHQ has been monitoring; 听：注意现在完成进行时。

sentences.en: The agency urges businesses to patch software promptly and to adopt robust, AI‑aware security protocols.
sentences.zh: 该机构敦促企业及时修补软件并采用强大、AI 友好的安全协议。
sentences.tip: 主干：agency urges; 听：注意 'promptly' 的弱读。

sentences.en: This warning follows a series of high‑profile breaches that cost companies millions in damages and reputational harm.
sentences.zh: 此警告跟随一系列高调漏洞，导致公司损失数百万并损害声誉。
sentences.tip: 主干：warning follows; 听：注意 'high‑profile breaches' 的连读。

sentences.en: Industry analysts predict that AI tools will become the main vector for cyberattacks in the next decade.
sentences.zh: 行业分析师预测，AI 工具将在未来十年内成为主要的网络攻击向量。
sentences.tip: 主干：analysts predict; 听：注意 'main vector' 的重音。

sentences.en: The UK government has pledged to invest billions in cyber resilience, aiming to protect critical infrastructure and public services.
sentences.zh: 英国政府承诺投入数十亿美元提升网络弹性，保护关键基础设施和公共服务。
sentences.tip: 主干：government pledged; 听：注意 'invest billions' 的弱化。

sentences.en: Citizens are encouraged to keep their devices updated and to report any suspicious activity to local authorities.
sentences.zh: 市民被鼓励保持设备更新，并向当地当局报告任何可疑活动。
sentences.tip: 主干：citizens encouraged; 听：注意 'keep devices updated' 的连读。

sentences.en: In the coming weeks, GCHQ will release a detailed guide on AI‑driven threat detection and mitigation strategies.
sentences.zh: 在接下来几周，GCHQ 将发布关于 AI 驱动威胁检测与缓解策略的详细指南。
sentences.tip: 主干：GCHQ will release; 听：注意 'AI‑driven' 的连读。

quiz.q: What is the main reason the UK government issued the warning?
options: AI tools are not used by hackers
quiz.explainZh: 政府警告是因为 AI 驱动的攻击揭露了长期存在的安全弱点。

quiz.q: Which agency is responsible for monitoring AI hacking tools in the UK?
quiz.explainZh: 英国网络机构 GCHQ 正在监控 AI 黑客工具。

articles.title: Crusoe Investor Bets on Solar and Batteries for Future AI Data Centers
articles.titleZh: Crusoe 投资者押注太阳能和电池供未来 AI 数据中心
articles.summaryZh: 未来 AI 数据中心每年需要数十吉瓦电力，一位 Crusoe 投资者认为太阳能和储能是最佳方案。

sentences.en: Next‑generation AI data centers will need tens of gigawatts of power each year.
sentences.zh: 未来的 AI 数据中心每年将需要数十吉瓦的电力。
sentences.tip: 主干：Next‑generation AI data centers will need…；听：注意“gigawatts”的发音，弱化“each year”。

focus.note: 常用来描述大规模电力需求

sentences.en: A key investor in the tech firm Crusoe sees solar power as the obvious solution.
sentences.zh: Crusoe 的一位重要投资者认为太阳能是明显的解决方案。
sentences.tip: 主干：A key investor…sees…as the obvious solution；听：连接词“as the”轻读。

sentences.en: He argues that batteries can store excess solar energy for use when the sun is low.
sentences.zh: 他认为电池可以储存多余的太阳能，在日照不足时使用。
sentences.tip: 主干：He argues that batteries can store…；听：注意“store excess solar energy”连读。

sentences.en: The data centers will host large AI models that require constant, reliable power supply.
sentences.zh: 这些数据中心将托管大型 AI 模型，需要持续、可靠的电力供应。
sentences.tip: 主干：The data centers will host…；听：强调“constant, reliable”。

sentences.en: Solar panels can generate electricity during daylight, reducing the need for fossil‑fuel generators.
sentences.zh: 太阳能板在白天发电，减少对化石燃料发电机的需求。
sentences.tip: 主干：Solar panels can generate…；听：弱化“during daylight”。

sentences.en: Energy storage batteries help smooth power fluctuations, ensuring the AI workloads run smoothly.
sentences.zh: 电池储能帮助平滑电力波动，确保 AI 工作负载顺利运行。
sentences.tip: 主干：Energy storage batteries help smooth…；听：注意“smoothly”轻读。

sentences.en: The investment also supports the broader shift toward greener, more sustainable data centers worldwide.
sentences.zh: 这项投资还支持全球向更绿色、更可持续数据中心的转变。
sentences.tip: 主干：The investment also supports…；听：强调“greener, more sustainable”。

focus.note: 可持续发展常用形容词

sentences.en: Industry analysts predict that solar and battery solutions could cut data center energy costs by up to 30 percent.
sentences.zh: 行业分析师预测，太阳能和电池方案可将数据中心能源成本降低多达 30%。
sentences.tip: 主干：Industry analysts predict that…；听：注意“could cut…by up to 30 percent”。

focus.meaning: 降低数据中心能源成本

sentences.en: Crusoe plans to pilot these technologies in its upcoming data center projects next year.
sentences.zh: Crusoe 计划在明年的新数据中心项目中试点这些技术。
sentences.tip: 主干：Crusoe plans to pilot…；听：弱化“next year”。

sentences.en: Stakeholders should watch for regulatory approvals and the pace of battery price reductions.
sentences.zh: 利益相关者应关注监管批准和电池价格下降的速度。
sentences.tip: 主干：Stakeholders should watch for…；听：注意“regulatory approvals”。

quiz.q: What is the main reason the investor favors solar power for AI data centers?
options: Because it is cheaper than fossil fuels
Because it reduces the need for batteries
Because it can be stored easily
quiz.explainZh: 投资者认为太阳能能减少对化石燃料发电机的需求，成本更低。

quiz.q: Which benefit does battery storage provide in this context?
options: It increases the size of data centers
It eliminates the need for solar panels
quiz.explainZh: 电池储能帮助平滑电力波动，确保 AI 工作负载顺利运行。

articles.title: Huang Says Succession Plan Adds Unnecessary Hierarchy
articles.titleZh: 黄仁勋认为接班计划会产生不必要的层级结构
articles.summaryZh: 英伟达创始人黄仁勋表示，接班计划会导致不必要的层级。公司最近两周正在测试没有创始人的运作方式。

sentences.en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said a succession plan creates unnecessary hierarchy.
sentences.zh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋表示，接班计划会产生不必要的层级结构。

sentences.en: The company has spent the last two weeks testing operations without its founder.
sentences.zh: 公司过去两周一直在测试没有创始人的运作方式。

sentences.en: During this period, employees reported that decision‑making became faster and more flexible.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，员工报告说决策变得更快、更灵活。

sentences.en: However, some executives noted that the absence of a single leader caused confusion in priorities.
sentences.zh: 然而，一些高管指出，缺少单一领导导致了优先级混乱。

sentences.en: Huang explained that a clear hierarchy can slow innovation by adding extra approval layers.
sentences.zh: 黄仁勋解释说，清晰的层级结构会通过增加额外的审批层来减缓创新。

sentences.en: He believes that empowering teams to self‑manage reduces bureaucracy and speeds product development.
sentences.zh: 他认为，赋予团队自我管理权可以减少官僚主义并加速产品开发。

sentences.en: NVIDIA’s board has approved a flexible leadership model that blends shared responsibility with clear accountability.
sentences.zh: 英伟达董事会批准了一种灵活的领导模式，融合了共享责任与明确问责。

sentences.en: Industry analysts say this approach could set a new standard for tech companies facing rapid change.
sentences.zh: 行业分析师表示，这种方法可能为面对快速变化的科技公司设定新的标准。

sentences.en: NVIDIA plans to monitor the model closely and adjust if any bottlenecks appear.
sentences.zh: 英伟达计划密切监测该模式，并在出现任何瓶颈时进行调整。

focus.meaning: 在出现任何瓶颈时进行调整

sentences.en: The next update will be released next month, giving stakeholders a clear view of the results.
sentences.zh: 下个月将发布下一次更新，让利益相关者清晰了解结果。

quiz.q: What did Jensen Huang say about a succession plan?
quiz.explainZh: 黄仁勋认为接班计划会产生不必要的层级结构。

quiz.q: How did employees describe decision‑making during the two‑week test?
quiz.explainZh: 员工报告说决策变得更快、更灵活。

articles.title: China Investigates Politburo Member Chen Jining
articles.titleZh: 中国调查政治局成员陈敬宁
articles.summaryZh: 中国调查了政治局成员陈敬宁，显示习近平最新的权力清洗正在继续。

sentences.en: China has launched an investigation into Shanghai’s Communist Party chief Chen Jining.
sentences.zh: 中国已对上海市委书记陈敬宁展开调查。
sentences.tip: 主干：China has launched an investigation；听：注意动词短语的弱化，‘investigation’ 轻读。

sentences.en: Chen Jining is a member of China’s elite Politburo, the country’s top leadership body.
sentences.zh: 陈敬宁是中国政治局成员，国家最高领导层。
sentences.tip: 主干：Chen Jining is a member；听：连读‘member of’；重音在‘Politburo’。

sentences.en: He is regarded as a potential future leader, a contender for higher office.
sentences.zh: 他被视为未来领导人，有望升任更高职位。
sentences.tip: 主干：He is regarded as a potential future leader；听：‘potential’ 轻读。

focus.text: regarded as a potential future leader

sentences.en: This is the fourth Politburo member to be probed since 2025.
sentences.zh: 这是自2025年以来第四位被调查的政治局成员。
sentences.tip: 主干：This is the fourth…；听：注意数字‘fourth’的弱化。

sentences.en: China’s anti-graft watchdog is investigating him for suspected severe violations of discipline and laws.
sentences.zh: 中国反腐机关正在以涉嫌严重违纪违法为由调查他。
sentences.tip: 主干：is investigating him；听：连读‘suspected severe violations’。

sentences.en: The investigation follows a common euphemism used by state media to hint at corruption.
sentences.zh: 调查采用了国家媒体常用的委婉语，暗示腐败。
sentences.tip: 主干：The investigation follows…；听：‘common euphemism’ 轻读。

sentences.en: Xi Jinping’s latest purge shows a continued effort to consolidate power within the Communist Party.
sentences.zh: 习近平最新的肃清显示党内持续巩固权力。
sentences.tip: 主干：Xi Jinping’s latest purge shows；听：连读‘latest purge’。

sentences.en: Observers expect more investigations in the coming months as the party tightens its control.
sentences.zh: 观察人士预计未来几个月会有更多调查，党将进一步加强控制。
sentences.tip: 主干：Observers expect more investigations；听：‘more investigations’ 轻读。

quiz.q: What is the main reason for the investigation into Chen Jining?
options: He has been involved in financial fraud
He is suspected of severe violations of discipline and laws
He is a rival of Xi Jinping
quiz.explainZh: 陈敬宁被调查是因为涉嫌严重违纪违法。

quiz.q: How many Politburo members have been investigated since 2025?
quiz.explainZh: 自2025年以来，已调查四名政治局成员。

articles.title: Colombia’s President Leads Supermarket Hostage Rescue
articles.titleZh: 哥伦比亚总统前往购物中心人质救援现场
articles.summaryZh: 哥伦比亚总统抵达卡塔赫纳购物中心，人质被枪手扣押，军警展开救援。

sentences.en: President Gustavo Petro arrived in Cartagena to oversee a supermarket hostage rescue operation.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚总统古斯塔沃·佩特罗抵达卡塔赫纳，监督购物中心人质救援行动。
sentences.tip: 主干：President arrived; 听：注意动词过去式的轻读。

focus.text: oversee a supermarket hostage rescue operation
focus.meaning: 监督购物中心人质救援行动

sentences.en: The standoff began early Tuesday and has lasted several hours, with gunmen holding at least twenty people inside.
sentences.zh: 这场僵局于周二早些时候开始，持续数小时，枪手在商店内扣押至少二十人。
sentences.tip: 主干：standoff began; 听：注意连读和弱化的冠词。

sentences.en: A large force of security personnel, navy officers, and special forces is now on the scene.
sentences.zh: 大量安全人员、海军官员和特种部队已抵达现场。
sentences.tip: 主干：A large force is on the scene; 听：注意连读的“force is”。

sentences.en: Abelardo de la Espriella, the president’s chief of staff, will take command of the operation.
sentences.zh: 佩特罗的参谋长阿贝拉多·德拉·埃斯普里埃拉将接管此次行动。
sentences.tip: 主干：will take command; 听：注意动词短语的连读。

sentences.en: The city’s police chief says the goal is to free hostages without civilian casualties.
sentences.zh: 市警局长表示目标是无平民伤亡地解救人质。
sentences.tip: 主干：goal is to free; 听：注意动词不定式的弱读。

focus.meaning: 无平民伤亡地解救人质

sentences.en: Cartagena is a popular tourist destination, making the incident especially concerning for travelers.
sentences.zh: 卡塔赫纳是热门旅游目的地，这使得事件对游客尤其令人担忧。
sentences.tip: 主干：is a popular tourist destination; 听：注意形容词短语的连读。

sentences.en: The government has urged residents to stay calm and follow official instructions.
sentences.zh: 政府敦促居民保持冷静并遵守官方指示。
sentences.tip: 主干：urged residents to stay calm; 听：注意动词不定式的弱化。

focus.text: stay calm and follow official instructions
focus.meaning: 保持冷静并遵守官方指示

sentences.en: Police expect the operation to conclude within the next few hours, but they remain cautious.
sentences.zh: 警方预计行动将在接下来几个小时内结束，但仍保持谨慎。
sentences.tip: 主干：expect the operation to conclude; 听：注意连读和弱化。

focus.text: conclude within the next few hours
focus.meaning: 在接下来几个小时内结束

sentences.en: International observers are monitoring the situation closely, hoping for a peaceful resolution.
sentences.zh: 国际观察者正密切关注局势，希望实现和平解决。
sentences.tip: 主干：are monitoring the situation; 听：注意动词现在进行时的弱读。

sentences.en: Updates will be provided as the rescue operation progresses and hostages are released.
sentences.zh: 随着救援行动进展和人质获释，将提供最新信息。
sentences.tip: 主干：updates will be provided; 听：注意未来式的连读。

quiz.q: Who is taking command of the hostage rescue operation?
quiz.explainZh: 阿贝拉多·德拉·埃斯普里埃拉是总统的参谋长，将接管行动。

quiz.q: What is the main goal of the operation according to the police chief?
options: To free hostages without civilian casualties

articles.title: Trump Deportation Battle Ends as Kilmar Ábrego García Leaves U.S. for Spain
articles.titleZh: 特朗普驱逐案结束：基尔马尔·阿布雷戈·加西亚离开美国前往西班牙
articles.summaryZh: 基尔马尔·阿布雷戈·加西亚离开美国，结束了特朗普政府的驱逐争议。此案成为美国移民议题的焦点。

sentences.en: Kilmar Ábrego García has left the United States for Spain, ending a long legal battle.
sentences.zh: 基尔马尔·阿布雷戈·加西亚已离开美国前往西班牙，结束了长期的法律争端。
sentences.tip: 主干：Kilmar Ábrego García has left the United States for Spain；听：注意连读和弱化的助动词。

sentences.en: He was previously ordered to return to El Salvador, but the U.S. court reversed that decision.
sentences.zh: 他曾被命令返回萨尔瓦多，但美国法院推翻了该决定。
sentences.tip: 主干：He was previously ordered to return；听：留意过去分词的弱读。

sentences.en: The case became a flash point in the debate over President Donald Trump's immigration agenda.
sentences.zh: 此案成为关于唐纳德·特朗普移民议程辩论的焦点。
sentences.tip: 主干：The case became a flash point；听：强调flash point的重音。

sentences.en: Supporters of the Trump administration praised the decision as a victory for law and order.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府的支持者称赞此决定是法律与秩序的胜利。
sentences.tip: 主干：Supporters praised the decision；听：注意连读和弱化的助动词。

sentences.en: Opponents argued that the ruling ignored human rights and the rights of asylum seekers.
sentences.zh: 反对者认为该裁决忽视了人权和寻求庇护者的权利。
sentences.tip: 主干：Opponents argued that the ruling；听：关注连读和弱化的助动词。

sentences.en: The U.S. Supreme Court declined to review the lower court’s decision, effectively ending the legal fight.
sentences.zh: 美国最高法院拒绝复核下级法院的决定，正式结束了这场法律争斗。
sentences.tip: 主干：The U.S. Supreme Court declined to review；听：注意复合动词的弱化。

sentences.en: Now García will settle in Spain, where he hopes to rebuild his life and career.
sentences.zh: 现在加西亚将定居西班牙，他希望在那儿重建生活和事业。
sentences.tip: 主干：García will settle in Spain；听：注意将来时的弱化。

sentences.en: The case highlights the ongoing tension between immigration enforcement and humanitarian concerns in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 此案凸显了美国移民执法与人道关怀之间的持续紧张关系。
sentences.tip: 主干：The case highlights the ongoing tension；听：注意连读和弱化的助动词。

sentences.en: Observers will watch how this decision influences future immigration policies and court rulings.
sentences.zh: 观察者将关注此决定如何影响未来的移民政策和法庭裁决。
sentences.tip: 主干：Observers will watch how this decision；听：注意将来时的弱化。

quiz.q: What was the final outcome for Kilmar Ábrego García?
options: He was deported to El Salvador
He left the U.S. for Spain
quiz.explainZh: 加西亚最终离开美国前往西班牙，结束了法律争端。

quiz.q: Which court declined to review the lower court’s decision?
quiz.explainZh: 美国最高法院拒绝复核下级法院的决定。
